title: I’m a beginner and made a haunted antique shop game on Roblox with Claude. I’ll play yours too
author: kaeya111
selftext:
I'd never made a Roblox game before, so I built this one with Claude. I chose what went in, tested it, recorded it and published it. Claude wrote the code and made the pictures.

It's called Haunted Antiques. You run a shop full of cursed antiques and visitors pay to see them, but the ghosts come out and you have to catch them. You can also dare them all to come at once for more cash.

I just added Reborn, so you can start over with a permanent earnings boost. My biggest problem now is getting real people to try it.

I'd love to know: was it clear what to do, and where did you get bored?

https://www.roblox.com/share?code=fa7602311a61b649980508577be16f14&type=ExperienceDetails&stamp=1795609169751

It's free with optional Robux purchases, and it's 16+ on Roblox, so you may need an age check.

Drop your game too and I'll try it and leave feedback.
